headline: Authorization certificate made mandatory for rent-a-car companies
summary: The Ministry of Trade has reorganized rules for rental vehicles, covering authorization certificates, vehicle age and mileage, deposits, consumer rights and fleet standards.
why: Car rental firms operate large vehicle fleets and depend on licensing and consumer-protection rules. New standards raise compliance costs and affect the sector's operating model.
